The '''Antared system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antared III]].<ref name="GH" />
